root_cause: Incorrect boundary comparison operator (>=) used to bound-check glyph_index against startGlyphID + glyphCount, when the array being indexed has exactly glyphCount elements starting at startGlyphID, making the valid range exclusive of startGlyphID + glyphCount, i.e. a classic off-by-one/fencepost error in range validation introduced during a from-scratch rewrite of GPOS kerning support.
findings: In tt_face_get_class(), when parsing a Format 1 ClassDef table for GPOS Pair Adjustment (class-based) kerning, the code validates that glyph_index falls within [startGlyphID, startGlyphID + glyphCount] using the condition `startGlyphID + glyphCount >= glyph_index`. This is an off-by-one error: the valid range for the ClassValueArray, which has exactly `glyphCount` entries indexed 0..glyphCount-1,
